articles.title: The Convergence of Pharmacy Benefits and Stop-Loss Insurance for Self-Funded Employers
articles.summary: Rising specialty drug costs and high-cost claims are increasingly intertwining pharmacy benefit management with stop-loss insurance decisions for self-funded organizations. This matters because uncontrolled pharmaceutical spending directly threatens stop-loss attachment points and overall plan viability, requiring a unified approach to risk management. Consequently, benefits leaders must closely coordinate their PBM strategies with stop-loss carriers to protect against catastrophic financial exposure and optimize employer health plan performance.
